title: Lee Designs SE5 Carbon Racer TC-5

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Troy Lee Designs SE5 Carbon Racer TC-5 is delivers competition-grade off-road impact absorption with maximum cooling throughput, pairing extreme cooling throughput with competition-grade roost protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1313g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~100 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Premium carbon MX helmet with MIPS-C2 multi-impact protection.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Troy Lee Designs SE5 Carbon Racer TC-5: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Troy's Dirt / MX lineup, the Lee Designs SE5 Carbon Racer TC-5 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Troy Lee Designs SE5 Carbon Racer TC-5 represents Troy's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~100 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Troy Lee Designs SE5 Carbon Racer TC-5 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
